title: Obtaining Posture Profile Details Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information on managing Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) posture profile use cases using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.

blocks.heading: Getting Details for All Posture Profiles V2

blocks.text: To get the details for all posture profiles:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint in the posture-profile-controller: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/posture.
Provide the customerId, the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/217246660302995456/posture.
View an example response

{ "totalPages": "13", "list": [ { "id": "217246660303020736", "creationTime": "1502955460", "modifiedBy": "72057594037928107", "name": "39845-registryTest", "postureUdid": "014b03ff-bcfd-4219-b574-5b7f74aa4a68", "zscalerCloud": "zscalerbeta" }, { "id": "217246660303021896", "modifiedTime": "1544470438", "creationTime": "1511380873", "modifiedBy": "72057594037928107", "name": "Android Test", "postureUdid": "4eb1ecd4-8e05-425f-b677-4340381ea849", "zscalerCloud": "zscalerbeta" } ] }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
This API supports pagination. To get a paginated response:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/{customerId}/posture?page=1&pagesize=20.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
Valid values for page and page size parameters.
View an example response

{ "totalPages": "15", "list": [ { "id": "217246660303020736", "creationTime": "1502955460", "modifiedBy": "72057594037928107", "name": "39845-registryTest (zscalerbeta.net)", "postureUdid": "014b03ff-bcfd-4219-b574-5b7f74aa4a68", "zscalerCloud": "zscalerbeta" }, { "id": "217246660303021896", "modifiedTime": "1544470438", "creationTime": "1511380873", "modifiedBy": "72057594037928107", "name": "Android Test (zscalerbeta.net)", "postureUdid": "4eb1ecd4-8e05-425f-b677-4340381ea849", "zscalerCloud": "zscalerbeta" } ] }

blocks.text: If not provided, the default page size is 20. The maximum page size is 500.
A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
This API supports a search option to search by features and fields. To search by features and fields:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/73186051597795328/posture&search={searchString}.
Provide the following in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.

Valid search string values. The search string values are in the format fieldName operator fieldValue. Only search string values that correspond to the values for valid fields and filters are supported. For example, the string name%20LIKE%20test is supported for the Name filter, using the Equals (EQ) operator, for the filter value test.
View an example response

{ "totalPages": "1", "totalCount": "1", "list": [ { "id": "72057594038041099", "modifiedTime": "0", "creationTime": "1624340878", "modifiedBy": "72057594037987389", "name": "test (cloud.net)", "postureUdid": "test", "zscalerCloud": "cloud" } ] }

blocks.text: If you use the ZPA API Portal or the Reference Guide to make your API calls, the search field string does not require any characters. For example, name%20LIKE%20test is name LIKE test.
A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

blocks.heading: Getting Details for a Particular Posture Profile

blocks.text: To get details for a particular posture profile:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint in the posture-profile-controller: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/posture/{id}.
Provide the following values in the request endpoint:
customerId: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.
id: The ID of the desired posture profile.
View an example response

{ "id": "217246660303022290", "creationTime": "1531369746", "modifiedBy": "72057594037928107", "name": "test123", "postureUdid": "519fe22c-bfd8-418a-ab9d-5c7f77f3ac54", "zscalerCloud": "zscalerbeta" }

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
